tagline: Shark Tank vet who bites back
summary: Barbara is a high-volume entrepreneur who views life as a series of pitches and negotiations, often using humor to deflect vulnerability. She is deeply invested in her daughter Kate and the legacy of her New York real estate empire. Off-camera, she is a candid mentor who values directness and dislikes beating around the bush.
